case_selection: full graph and fixed original node IDs; no degree or timing selection
compilation_failure_policy: retain unavailable or incorrect; no eager fallback or broad strong victory

computation.feature_conditioning: divide by max(1, maximum absolute original feature)
computation.operations: gather, incoming sum, degree mean, seeded projections, ReLU and residual
computation.weight_conditioning: each projection column absolute sum 0.125; bias bounded by 0.001
computation.window_boundary: update only declared target nodes; external source features stay fixed each layer

edge_semantics: original directed citations, duplicates retained, no added edges
